title: RawIngestV1
description: Bus message: ulpf.raw.ingest.v1 — raw ingestion envelope published by ingestion-svc.

lineage_id.description: UUIDv4, generated once at ingestion, never reused.

raw_bytes_b64.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes. Omitted (null) when payload exceeds bus.max_inline_bytes — use storage_pointer instead.

storage_pointer.description: URI to the raw store location: raw_store://chunk_<id>/offset_<n>

sha256_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the raw bytes.

char_encoding.description: Detected character encoding. Metadata only — never used to transform stored bytes.
